# Dependency Graph: Visualize Dependency Map for Jira

> Jira Cloud app by VortexWeb Innovations to view and visualize Jira dependencies as an interactive dependency map, from blockers and linked issues to the full epic-to-subtask dependency tree. About 3,500 people use it on 185 Jira sites (October 2026). Free for up to 10 users.

Key facts:
- Opens from the issue view, project page, global page, issue search, board, backlog, sprint, dashboard and Jira Service Management queue.
- Starts a graph from a JQL query, a saved filter, an epic, a release or a single work item.
- Highlights an issue's whole dependency path; the "Cross Epic connection" filter keeps only links between different epics; grouping by dependency level shows which work items can start first.
- 12 groupings, 18 filters, 70+ card fields; create and delete links on the graph.
- Works across projects with existing Jira links; no setup and no Jira Premium needed. Jira Cloud only.
- Runs on Atlassian; sends no issue data outside Atlassian. View settings and search history are saved as Jira user properties in each user's own account.
